---
title: "Optimal Scenario Prediction Using Map Characteristics"
output: pdf_document
---

# Preprocessing
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nnet)
# library(MASS)

maps_df = read_csv("/work/users/p/w/pwlin/output/maps.csv")
maps_info_df = maps_df %>% select(map, equipoise, geoscale, sc_max_dist_normalized) %>%
                            mutate(equipoise = 100*equipoise)

thresholds_df = read_csv("/work/users/p/w/pwlin/full_output_sens/all_scenarios.csv", col_select = c(1, 2, 6, 7, 8), skip = 1)
names(thresholds_df) = c("map", "var", "value", "sensitivity", "threshold")
thresholds_df$sensitivity = factor(thresholds_df$sensitivity)
thresholds_df = thresholds_df %>% mutate(value = ifelse(str_detect(var, "mRS"), 1000 * value, value))

psc_thresholds_df = read_csv("/work/users/p/w/pwlin/full_output_sens/psc_scenarios.csv", col_select = c(1, 2, 6, 7, 8), skip = 1)
names(psc_thresholds_df) = c("map", "var", "value", "sensitivity", "threshold")
psc_thresholds_df$sensitivity = factor(psc_thresholds_df$sensitivity)
psc_thresholds_df = psc_thresholds_df %>% mutate(value = ifelse(str_detect(var, "mRS"), 1000 * value, value))
```

# Models for all patients

## mRS for ischemic patients
```{r}
thresh_results = thresholds_df %>% filter(var == "mRS_ischemic")
combined_df = thresh_results %>% left_join(maps_info_df)

sensitivity_mod = multinom(sensitivity ~ equipoise + geoscale + sc_max_dist_normalized, data = combined_df)
threshold_mod = lm(threshold ~ equipoise + geoscale + sc_max_dist_normalized, data = combined_df)
treatment_mod = lm(value ~ equipoise + geoscale + sc_max_dist_normalized, data = combined_df)

summary(sensitivity_mod)
summary(threshold_mod)
summary(treatment_mod)

# pairs(combined_df %>% select(geoscale, equipoise, threshold),
#         horInd = 3, verInd = 1:2, labels = c("geoscale", "equipoise", "threshold"))

# pairs(combined_df %>% select(geoscale, equipoise, value),
#         horInd = 3, verInd = 1:2, labels = c("geoscale", "equipoise", "treatment"))

plot(threshold_mod, which = c(1,3))
plot(treatment_mod, which = c(1,3))
```

# Models for PSC patients

## Time to EVT for LVO patients
```{r}
thresh_results = psc_thresholds_df %>% filter(var == "time_evt_lvo")
combined_df = thresh_results %>% left_join(maps_info_df)


sensitivity_mod = glm(sensitivity ~ equipoise + geoscale + sc_max_dist_normalized, data = combined_df, family=binomial)
threshold_mod = lm(threshold ~ equipoise + geoscale + sc_max_dist_normalized, data = combined_df)
treatment_mod = lm(value ~ equipoise + geoscale + sc_max_dist_normalized, data = combined_df)

summary(sensitivity_mod)
abs(summary(sensitivity_mod)$coefficients/summary(sensitivity_mod)$standard.errors)

summary(threshold_mod)
summary(treatment_mod)

# pairs(combined_df %>% select(geoscale, equipoise, threshold),
#         horInd = 3, verInd = 1:2, labels = c("geoscale", "equipoise", "threshold"))

# pairs(combined_df %>% select(geoscale, equipoise, value),
#         horInd = 3, verInd = 1:2, labels = c("geoscale", "equipoise", "treatment"))

plot(threshold_mod, which = c(1,3))
plot(treatment_mod, which = c(1,3))
```
